sources.title: Unstaked APT never withdrawn
sources.summary: You unstaked APT from a Aptos delegation pool. The lockup ended and the APT is withdrawable, but it was never withdrawn.
sources.inclusionRule: R2 ended position: unlock completed (stake is inactive, or pending-inactive in a pool whose validator left the set).

protocolStatus.evidence: Aptos framework module 0x1::delegation_pool.

howTo: Open the delegation pool in your wallet's staking view and withdraw.
Or call 0x1::delegation_pool::withdraw(pool, amount) from the account that delegated.

run.scope: current_delegator_balances rows with pool_type=inactive_shares and shares>0 (stake_processor)

sanity.check: per pool: sum of delegator inactive stake <= stake::get_stake(pool).inactive

sources.title: APT staked with a validator that stopped
sources.summary: Your APT is still staked in a Aptos delegation pool whose validator left the validator set. It earns nothing and can be unlocked and withdrawn right away.
sources.inclusionRule: R2 ended position: the pool's validator is inactive (stake::get_validator_state = 4), so staking stopped; unlock and withdraw are immediate.

protocolStatus.evidence: Aptos framework module 0x1::delegation_pool; per-pool validator state read each run.

howTo: In your wallet's staking view, unlock the stake from this validator, then withdraw it. With the validator out of the set, the withdrawal is available immediately.
Or call 0x1::delegation_pool::unlock(pool, amount), then 0x1::delegation_pool::withdraw(pool, amount).

run.scope: active_shares rows (shares > 0) in delegation pools whose validator state is inactive (4) at enumeration time

sanity.check: per pool: sum of delegator active stake <= stake::get_stake(pool).active

sources.title: Echelon supply left in frozen markets
sources.summary: Echelon froze some of its Aptos lending markets: no new borrowing. Supply you left there earns little or nothing and waits on Echelon winding the market down. Counted only for suppliers without Echelon debt.
sources.inclusionRule: R2: Echelon froze the market (collateral factor 0, borrow cap 0), so the supply sits nearly idle until a wind-down; the freeze is the effective date (issue #10, option (b)). R4: suppliers with any Echelon debt are left out. Both decided 2026-10-20.

protocolStatus.evidence: 21 of 30 markets frozen on chain (collateral factor 0, borrow cap 0); the freeze dates come from Echelon's admin transactions, 2025-05-03 to 2026-10-04. Aptos Foundation: Echelon "helped sunset bridge-wrapped assets".

howTo: Withdraw in the Echelon app (Aptos), or

call 0xc6bc659f1649553c1a3fa05d9727433dc03843baac29473c817d06d39e7621ba::scripts::withdraw_all<coin type>(market) for a Coin market, or 0xc6bc659f1649553c1a3fa05d9727433dc03843baac29473c817d06d39e7621ba::scripts::withdraw_all_fa(market) for a fungible-asset market, from the supplying account.
Holding THL, Wormhole WETH, STONE, SBTC or a Thala LPT on Echelon (no valid price) blocks every other withdrawal: withdraw that first.

run.scope: senders of 0xc6bc659f1649553c1a3fa05d9727433dc03843baac29473c817d06d39e7621ba::scripts::supply, 0xc6bc659f1649553c1a3fa05d9727433dc03843baac29473c817d06d39e7621ba::scripts::withdraw, 0xc6bc659f1649553c1a3fa05d9727433dc03843baac29473c817d06d39e7621ba::scripts::withdraw_all, 0xc6bc659f1649553c1a3fa05d9727433dc03843baac29473c817d06d39e7621ba::scripts::supply_fa, 0xc6bc659f1649553c1a3fa05d9727433dc03843baac29473c817d06d39e7621ba::scripts::withdraw_fa, 0xc6bc659f1649553c1a3fa05d9727433dc03843baac29473c817d06d39e7621ba::scripts::withdraw_all_fa, 0xc6bc659f1649553c1a3fa05d9727433dc03843baac29473c817d06d39e7621ba::scripts::borrow from version 7694000000, 0xc6bc659f1649553c1a3fa05d9727433dc03843baac29473c817d06d39e7621ba::scripts::borrow_fa from version 7694000000, 0xc6bc659f1649553c1a3fa05d9727433dc03843baac29473c817d06d39e7621ba::scripts::repay from version 7694000000, 0xc6bc659f1649553c1a3fa05d9727433dc03843baac29473c817d06d39e7621ba::scripts::repay_all from version 7694000000, 0xc6bc659f1649553c1a3fa05d9727433dc03843baac29473c817d06d39e7621ba::scripts::repay_fa from version 7694000000, 0xc6bc659f1649553c1a3fa05d9727433dc03843baac29473c817d06d39e7621ba::scripts::repay_all_fa from version 7694000000 entry calls (calls made by other contracts excluded)
